analysis:
Examined all supplied test source, patches and metadata against the indexed model, particularly T-041, TB-007, TB-003, A-001 and availability concerns. No concrete security regression is established by these test changes; test expectations are not proof of production controls.

Under provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/KVCacheSSD/, SSDHybridCheckpointCoordinationTests.swift:21-86 tests overlapping readers, exclusive recency updates and reauthentication of outdated receipts without ciphertext or epoch changes. Lines 89-237 cover cancellation retaining active leases, writer precedence, retirement/scan exclusion and authenticated corruption rejection; lines 240-351 cover queued lifecycle cleanup, TTL/index rechecks and cross-store coordination. SSDHybridCheckpointRecencyTests.swift:83-179 adds refresh-interval receipt checks and reconciliation of in-memory hits into persisted recency before whole-root expiry, followed by expiry at the last hit's TTL. SSDOwnedEntryRetirementTests.swift:36-66 tests cutoff-aware retirement, preservation of newer mtimes/file identities, and unconditional budget retirement. Existing tests retain epoch ownership, mutation reconciliation and foreign-path rejection checks. The SSDShorterCheckpointRestoreTests.swift patch changes same-ID replacement testing to overlap reads; only metadata and a truncated orientation patch are supplied.

Integration must verify the production coordinator, staging registration/receipt validation, retirement and shared disk-budget maintainer together: sole-reader mutation must be atomic against arriving readers/writers; cancellation and same-ID replacement must not leak leases/reservations; unchanged receipts must not bypass authentication after external mutation; recency reconciliation must retain the T-041 maximum sliding TTL and permit budget eviction. Production implementations and complete shorter-restore changes are outside this batch, leaving these material contracts unresolved. No supplied change establishes altered authorization, attestation, wire encryption, billing or account-salt isolation.
